item.title: Gardaí seize €156,000 worth of cannabis in second Cavan Town property
item.description: As part of a continuing investigation, the Cavan Drugs Unit searched an additional property in Cavan town on Friday 6th March 2026. During the search of this second property, Gardaí discovered 7.8 kilograms of suspected cannabis with an estimated value of €156,000. It follows a previous discovery of cannabis in a property in Cavan Town valued at €125,000. This brings the total value of the 2 seizures to €281,000. item.title: Fifty years since Castleblayney bombing marked today
item.description: Today marks 50 years since the Castleblayney bombing. A wreath laying ceremony will be held at the memorial site on the Main Street at 2pm this afternoon. The special event is to honour the victims and all those impacted by the event. At around 8.20pm on March 7th, a car bomb, for which no warning had been given, exploded outside the Three Star Inn in Castleblayney, killing 56 year-old Patrick (Packie) Mone instantly and injuring 17 people. item.title: Almost €40,000 earmarked for local agricultural shows
item.description: Just under €40,000 has been earmarked for agricultural shows across Cavan and Monaghan. The announcement comes from Minister Dara Calleary, who confirmed 126 shows nationwide will benefit from the funding. This includes over €10,000 allocated to Virginia Agricultural show, while €9,200 will be received by Arva, Castleblayney and Tydavnet shows respectively. item.title: Cavan County Museum set to celebrate 30th anniversary
item.description: Cavan County Museum is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year when it was officially opened by the then President Mary Robinson. item.title: Gardaí reissue appeal over burglaries in Cavan
item.description: Gardai have reissued their appeal over two separate burglaries which took place on the same day in Cavan last month. Gardai in Cavan are appealing for anyone with information or who noticed any suspicious activity to get in touch. Gardai are investigating a burglary that occurred in Drumavanagh, Cavan between the hours of 4pm and 6pm. The incident took place on the 7th of February. item.title: Major turnout at 50th anniversary ceremony of Castleblayney bombing
item.description: A well-attended wreath-laying ceremony has taken place to mark 50 years since the Castleblayney bombing. A no-warning car bomb exploded outside the Three Star Inn on Main Street at 8:20pm on the 7th of March 1976, with 56-year-old man, Patrick 'Packie' Mone, killed in the blast. A review was launched into the incident in March 2020, and families who lost loved ones in attacks related to the Glenanne Gang are awaiting the publication of Operation Denton. item.title: Sligo crush Cavan in hurling league
item.description: Cavan fell to a heavy defeat in division four this afternoon, as Sligo put eight goals past them. Sligo scoring a 8-19 to 12-point win at the Enniscrone Kilglass GAA grounds. Gerard O’Kelly Lynch opened the scoring with a goal for Sligo after a minute of play. Advertisement Andrew Kilcullen, Conor Hanniffy and Thomas Cawley all found the back of the Cavan net in the first-half. item.title: Man appears at special sitting over €280,000 Cavan drug seizure
item.description: A 36-year-old man has appeared before a special sitting of Trim District Court this evening charged in relation to the seizure of €281,000 worth of cannabis. Lithuanian national Justas Sapransaukas of no fixed abode appeared before Judge Raymond Finnegan over a number of a charges that alleges he was in possession of the drugs.
